name: Heidelberg Instruments Mikrotechnik GmbH
india_angle: In India, Heidelberg Instruments is represented by Labindia Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
summary: Heidelberg Instruments Mikrotechnik GmbH is a leader in the design and manufacture of high-precision laser lithography systems and maskless aligners, serving the semiconductor industry with advanced tools for micro- and nanofabrication. Their equipment supports a wide range of applications, including photomask production and advanced packaging, enabling high-resolution patterning and rapid prototyping.
